column1: # Specs whose output differs from openapi-typescript 6.7.0 because of a 6.7.0 bug; openapi-ts-rs emits the correct type.
# A: percent-encoded $ref pointers left encoded, so the lookup names a key that does not exist
# B: YAML dates turned into Date objects, so enum "2011-01-01" becomes "2011-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
# C: string enum values under a non-string type emitted unquoted, naming types that do not exist
# D: parameters $ref'd by array index (…/parameters/2) silently dropped
# E: backslashes not escaped in string literals, so "N\A" becomes "NA"
# F: non-pointer fragments (file.yaml#Name) ignored, so the ref points at the whole file
